summary: P3 lands its outcome completely: the routing test and both get_helm_images reads now key on the resolved chart_name, so the local-chart path no longer depends on the config directory name. I verified inertness independently (the only top-level `chart:` in the tree is `chart: null`) and mutation-checked all three sites individually — each is caught by a test on its own. One advisory finding: a third, unrecorded site in recommend_resources.py carries the same config-directory keying.
